rubric.item: Current state read before writes (main-agent get_product by SKU or read-only subagent)
rubric.note: Main agent read CV-HOOK-01/02/03 with medusa.get_product (calls 1-3) before any update.

rubric.item: All three SKUs in one answer with actual saved result and erp_url; nothing described as published; no unrelated field claimed changed
rubric.note: Table shows all three as succeeded with updated.product = true, gives each erp_url, says publishing is left to the user, and says only the title changed.

rubric.item: Subagents read-only; every update_product from main agent, one per product; otherwise sequential reads
rubric.note: No subagent was used. The reads ran in order, followed by exactly one main-agent update_product per product, each with only product_id and title.

rubric.item: One consolidated report, not per-SKU question/confirmation; Chinese
rubric.note: A single Chinese report. Its only optional follow-up asks about the marketplace listing and is not a per-SKU confirmation.

agent_unsure: The agent noted that it saved the Chinese titles even though the merchant's preference is Spanish copy for Amazon ES, that it read "title" as the product catalog title rather than the ES listing, and that it chose sequential reads over a read-only subagent.
